{{Top|leg}}
'''Seducer plants''' were plants which were native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[F'tral]]. They used sweet smelling nectar to lure prey in. As the prey fed on the nectar it was slowly strangled by the plant's vines and stems.
